list.name: Idle repaint
list.expr: {service_name="ion-desktop", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="device-metrics" | msg="idle repaint detected"

description: Host load and every Ion process, from the sample lines each process logs every 30 s. Works with telemetry off. Studio's Device Metrics appear only here: they never leave the device.

panels.title: Devices reporting
panels.description: Devices that logged a System Metrics sample in the time range, within the Device and User filters.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host_name) (count_over_time({service_name="ion-engine", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="sysmetrics" | msg=~"system metrics sample|HIGH MEMORY" [$__range])))

panels.title: Host CPU in use
panels.description: Share of all host CPUs in use since the previous sample, 0..1; steal time counts as busy. Source: engine.jsonl tag=sysmetrics fields.host_cpu_utilization.

targets.expr: avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-engine", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="sysmetrics" | msg=~"system metrics sample|HIGH MEMORY" | fields_host_cpu_utilization != "" | unwrap fields_host_cpu_utilization [5m]))

panels.title: Host memory available and disk free
panels.description: Memory available to new work (inside a limited container, the limit less its use), and free space on the volume holding the engine's data (systemMetrics.diskPath, default ~/.ion). Source: engine.jsonl fields.host_memory_available_bytes, host_disk_free_bytes.

targets.expr: avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-engine", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="sysmetrics" | msg=~"system metrics sample|HIGH MEMORY" | fields_host_memory_available_bytes != "" | unwrap fields_host_memory_available_bytes [5m]))

avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-engine", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="sysmetrics" | msg=~"system metrics sample|HIGH MEMORY" | fields_host_disk_free_bytes != "" | unwrap fields_host_disk_free_bytes [5m]))

panels.title: CPU by engine process role, selected devices
panels.description: Summed CPU of each role in the engine's own process tree, added up across the selected devices; 100 = one full core. Pick one device to see one machine. Source: engine.jsonl fields.<role>_cpu_percent.

panels.title: Studio server process CPU
panels.description: The Ion Studio Server's own CPU (100 = one core). Its resident memory is fields.server_rss_bytes on the same line. Source: server.jsonl tag=system-metrics fields.server_cpu_percent.

targets.expr: avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-server", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="system-metrics" | msg="system metrics sample" | fields_server_cpu_percent != "" | unwrap fields_server_cpu_percent [5m]))

panels.title: Studio processes: CPU and GPU
panels.description: Ion Studio's own Electron processes on this device: all of them, the GPU helper, and the renderer. GPU time is measured on macOS only. Source: desktop.jsonl tag=device-metrics.

targets.expr: avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-desktop", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="device-metrics" | msg="device metrics sample" | fields_studio_cpu_percent != "" | unwrap fields_studio_cpu_percent [5m]))

avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-desktop", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="device-metrics" | msg="device metrics sample" | fields_gpu_helper_gpu_percent != "" | unwrap fields_gpu_helper_gpu_percent [5m]))

avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-desktop", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="device-metrics" | msg="device metrics sample" | fields_renderer_cpu_percent != "" | unwrap fields_renderer_cpu_percent [5m]))

panels.title: Idle-repaint warnings
panels.description: Times Studio's GPU helper or a renderer stayed busy while no Studio window had focus or the machine was idle: the sign of an animation that never stops repainting. Limits are Device settings (idleRepaint* in desktop.json). Source: desktop.jsonl msg="idle repaint detected".

targets.expr: sum by (host_name) (count_over_time({service_name="ion-desktop", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="device-metrics" | msg="idle repaint detected" [$__interval]))
